high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white portrait of William Shakespeare, the renowned English playwright and poet. The portrait is a formal, classical-style painting, likely from his lifetime, showing him with a serious expression. He has a prominent mustache and beard, and his hair is styled in a manner typical of the 16th century. Below the portrait, there is a quote attributed to Hamlet: "There is nothing either good or bad, but thinking makes it so." This quote is followed by an explanatory text that elaborates on the philosophical idea presented in the quote.
